sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail Sale via Internet - Marketplace FBA Store

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–People's Republic of China Bilateral Investment Treaty (1984)
France–People's Republic of China Double Taxation Agreement (2013)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Monetary and Financial Code, Articles L561-1 et seq. (AML/CFT); Commercial Code, Article R123-166-2 (UBO declaration); Law No. 2016-1691 of 9 December 2016 (Sapin II); Decree No. 2017-1094 of 8 June 2017; Ordinance No. 2020-115 of 12 February 2020 (AMLD5 transposition)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original or certified copy of passport of each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport/identity authority of the UBO's country of nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or French consular legalization if originating state is not a Hague Convention member)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement) of each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or French consular legalization if originating state is not a Hague Convention member)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and good standing (Kbis equivalent) of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter for the corporate shareholder or UBO (for French bank account opening / fund source verification)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if notarized; otherwise consular legalization if required by the receiving institution

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all legal representatives, directors, and ultimate beneficial owners against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions Dataset, and French DG Trésor asset-freeze decisions before incorporation and on a rolling basis. PEP determination applies FATF Interpretive Note to Recommendation 12 and French transposition in Monetary and Financial Code, Article L561-10. For this low-risk e-commerce marketplace segment, simplified due diligence is permissible but does not reduce the obligation to screen and document.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); RNE and INPI data search (data.inpi.fr)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in Latin script. Non-Latin scripts are transliterated into the Latin alphabet. The name must not be contrary to French public policy, misleading, or infringe prior trademarks/company names. A French translation may be required for foreign-language designations used in France.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be renewed once for an additional four-month period by written request to the INPI or via the formalities portal before expiry. Upon rejection, the applicant may appeal to the President of the competent Tribunal Judiciaire (commercial division) within 15 days of notification or may immediately amend and resubmit a new name through the Guichet unique. After registration, any challenge must be brought by judicial action.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for an SAS engaged in online marketplace sales provided that the registered office is located in France and the address is not a postal box only. Commercial domiciliation by an authorised provider is allowed for a maximum of five years, after which the company must either renew for justified circumstances or establish a physical establishment. Banks and financial service providers may impose additional substance requirements for merchant accounts.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Estimated at 3–5% per annum for a low-risk e-commerce seller; the DGFiP may carry out unannounced checks where VAT or transfer-pricing red flags arise, and the registered office must allow receipt of administrative correspondence and inspection of statutory records.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of SAS articles of association (statuts) by a French avocat
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French legal counsel (member of a Bar)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a standard e-commerce marketplace SAS (EUR 850–1,200, excl. VAT)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and availability check on RNE/INPI databases
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Nominal online search or internal compliance fee, if charged by counsel; no statutory charge for search alone

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal publication of the incorporation notice in an approved legal gazette (annonce légale)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Legal journal publisher (e.g., Journal Spécial des Sociétés, Les Échos, Midi Libre)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration of the SAS with the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS/Kbis certificate)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Paris or competent regional court)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official court registry fee schedule (approx. EUR 61.60 plus electronic handling)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille and certified French translation of foreign UBO and shareholder documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Foreign notary/apostille authority and French certified translator (traducteur assermenté)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-document apostille and translation costs; typical total EUR 300–400 for 2–3 documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO declaration (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) preparation and filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory fee for the declaration itself; service fee based on professional hourly rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office domiciliation (virtual commercial address) for 12 months
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark EUR 120–300 per annum depending on address and services

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce) Articles L.227-1 to L.227-20 (SAS regime); Articles L.210-1 to L.210-17 (general company law); Articles R.123-30 to R.123-55 (RCS filing obligations)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) administered by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; filings through the official online portal Guichet des Formalités des Entreprises
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de création d'une personne morale and the statutory Application Form M0 (Dossier de Création d'Entreprise) filed electronically
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum capital for a SAS; articles may set capital freely, typically €1 to €100. Cash contributions must be at least 50% paid-up on incorporation and the balance within 5 years; in-kind contributions must be fully paid-up and are subject to a statutory auditor's valuation report unless the shareholders unanimously waive it. No escrow account is legally mandatory for cash contributions, but funds must remain on deposit with a French bank or an approved depositary until the RCS registration certificate is issued if substantive capital is declared.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: that the incorporation formalities for the SAS be completed in accordance with the signed Articles of Association; the registered office be established at 34 Rue de Seine, 75006 Paris, France; each subscriber accepts the allotted shares and pays the required contributions; the appointment of [Name] as President of the SAS with sole management powers, and the appointment of [Name] as General Manager and [Name] as Compliance Officer, are confirmed with powers to open bank accounts, affix the corporate seal, and file all required declarations. All management actions authorized herein are ratified in the corporate records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Execute Articles of Association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Private notary or founders jointly (authentic or signed private deeds), subsequently filed via the Guichet des Formalités des Entreprises
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the SAS constitution deed containing corporate name, corporate purpose (limited to online retail and e-commerce), share capital, registered office, special governance rules including appointment and powers of the President, and the rights of shareholders. Verify that non-cash contributions are supported by audited valuations. Sign the Articles individually or through authorized counsel, and ensure each founder receives an original copy. For the registration, execute an 'attestation de dépôt de fonds' for any cash capital contribution if capital exceeds the statutory threshold or if the chosen bank requests a blocked-account certificate.
required_dossiers: Articles of Association (Statuts) signed and dated
Bank deposit certificate or attestation of funds for share capital
Statutory auditor's report on in-kind contributions (if any)
List of apport/contribution documents
Identity cards/passports of the founders and President
Proof of availability of the corporate name (INPI pre-reservation optional)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Guillotine rejects the dossier because of incomplete signatures or missing capital deposit proof, cure within 15 days by uploading the corrected Dossier de Création through the Guichet portal; the filing is automatically re-assessed without penalty. For substantive conflicts, request a directive and written explanation from the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publish Mandatory Legal Announcement in a Journal d'Annonces Légales
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State-licensed French legal gazette (Journal Spécialisé d'Annonces Légales) approved by the prefecture of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare a formal incorporation notice containing the exact corporate name, corporate purpose, registered office, share capital, President's identity, and RCS office where the company is to be registered. Submit the notice to the publisher, pay the regulated fee, and obtain an 'attestation de parution'. The announcement must appear within one week before the RCS filing or at the same time
required_dossiers: Settlement of the legal publication fee
Text of the announcement, signed by a founder
Power of attorney if filed by a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the newspaper misses a naming provision, publish an amended notice immediately in the same journal without fee, using a revised text approved by the Greffe.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Incorporation Application via Guichet des Formalités des Entreprises
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet des Formalités des Entreprises – official government single-window portal; documents transmitted to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce for registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the unified online form (Dossier de Création d'Entreprise) and upload the incorporated Articles, the legal announcement certificate, the capital deposit attestation, the company's proposed registration details, and identity documents. Select the 'SAS' category and the optional separate 'activité e-commerce' classification. Electronically sign the form with the President. Pay the applicable greffe fee online. The Greffe reviews the file and issues the registration certificate (extrait Kbis) within 3 to 7 business days, subject to legal conflicts.
required_dossiers: Articles of Association (authenticated copy)
Attestation de parution in a legal gazette
Bank deposit certificate or attestation of caretaking
Valid identification documents
Completed application Form M0
Proof of registered office (lease/ownership deed)
Sworn undertaking of compliance by the President
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe issues a 'rejet' (rejection) due to an unregistered corporate purpose or non-compliant governance clause, refile a corrected dossier within 30 days; legal fees are not reimposed, and the company becomes registered retroactively if resolved within the statutory time. If the rejection relates to the President's disqualification, appoint a substitute President and refile.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Extrait Kbis, VAT and Social Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, subsequently the French Tax Authorities (DGFIP) and URSSAF via automated data transfer
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once registered, download the certified original of the 'extrait Kbis' (the official corporate identity extract). The DGFIP automatically assigns the SIREN and SIRET number, and the VAT identification number is communicated by the tax office to which the RCS data is forwarded. File for separate domiciliation or physical trade license if needed; for pure e-commerce activities, no professional physical license applies, yet the company must apply for an EORI number if importing goods into the EU through customs.
required_dossiers: Extrait Kbis from the Greffe
Corporate bank account proof
French tax data and VAT number (issued automatically)
Customs registration for EORI (if importing goods)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VAT or SIRET numbers are delayed beyond 10 days, apply to the nearest Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) with the Kbis and mention the delay; administrative corrections are processed within 30 days. For the EORI, if rejected, re-apply to the Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – ISIC 4791 retail sale via e-commerce does not require an industrial license in France; administrative oversight remains with the Direction Départementale de la Protection des Populations (DDPP) for consumer protection and product safety.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sectoral operating permit required for pure cross-border marketplace retail; the principal registration remains the RCS/Kbis and, where applicable, an EORI number for customs handling.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Inspection des Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement (DREAL – De l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – the business premise is an office/warehouse used for administrative and logistics orchestration, not a listed installation under the ICPE norms; an EIA screening is not required for this activity.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to effluent or VOC emissions; if a warehouse with cold storage is later used, compliance with European F-Gas Regulation (EU) 517/2014, the Code de l'Environnement Article R.543-75 for leak checks, and the relevant municipal wastewater ordinance (e.g., City of Paris sanitation code) applies; all packaging must comply with French extended producer responsibility (EPR) obligations under the AGEC law for paper and plastic.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: General workplace safety clearance for the registered office is required: the office must not exceed REACH/RMS occupational safety thresholds under the Code du Travail. A fire safety attestation is required only when the premises host more than 19 employees or are open to the public. For a standard e-commerce office, an employer self-assessment under the single risk document (DUERP) and installation of basic fire extinguishers are sufficient; no pre-activity civil defense approval is needed.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) and Customs Administration (Douane), official portal https://www.impots.gouv.fr/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French SAS obtains SIREN/SIRET from INSEE upon incorporation and registers for VAT identification number (FR followed by 11 digits) with DGFiP via guichet-entreprises.fr or impots.gouv.fr; foreign entities register for tax purposes if having French PE, appoint fiscal representative, and apply for TIN and VAT ID through the same portals.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available; corporate tax applies at entity level with no hybrid entity classification elections, though ATAD hybrid mismatch rules govern certain instruments.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing (facturation électronique) for B2B sales with API integration to tax authorities, QR code digital stamping, and automated clearance for VAT compliance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate applies to exports of goods to non-EU countries and certain offshore services; eligibility requires issuance of export invoice, proof of actual export outside EU, and non-domestic use.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fines up to 80% of evaded VAT, interest surcharges, potential criminal sanctions, and full retrospective clawback of zero-rated amounts with loss of refund eligibility upon audit if documentation insufficient.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Central Bank of France), acting in coordination with the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury, Ministry of Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty), which retains statutory authority over foreign-exchange controls, capital-movement regulation and investment screening under Articles L.151-1 to L.165-1 of the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier). Banking licensing and AML supervision are exercised by the ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution). The Banque de France also serves as the sole competent authority for balance-of-payments statistics and cross-border payment reporting.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full EEA capital-account convertibility. France applies Articles 63 to 66 TFEU and the EU Capital Movements Directive; restrictions exist only under EU safeguard clauses. Current-account transactions (Amazon FBA proceeds, supplier payments, logistics and marketing costs) are freely convertible and require no prior Treasury authorization. Capital-account items (SAS share-capital injection, intra-group loans, profit and dividend remittance) are equally unrestricted. Frictions are limited to (i) the domestic dividend withholding regime (generally 25% under the 2024 finance-law framework and 30% standard flat tax for distributions, subject to treaty relief), (ii) Banque de France statistical reporting obligations for cross-border financial flows, and (iii) standard banking source-of-funds verification. No obligation exists to route FBA proceeds through a French bank; any ACPR-supervised PSP with an EEA passport may lawfully settle the SAS receipts.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. France imposes no export-proceeds surrender requirement, no statutory conversion ratio, and no repatriation timeline for export receipts. The SAS may retain USD, GBP or CNY proceeds in foreign-currency accounts at any licensed bank or ACPR-compliant payment institution. Administrative duties are limited to (i) Banque de France balance-of-payments data filing for qualifying cross-border transfers, (ii) customs declaration of physical cash movements of EUR 10,000 or more, and (iii) retention of underlying transaction documents (Amazon settlement statements, customs declarations, import invoices) for anti-money-laundering and treasury audit purposes.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital escrow account (blocked compte de dépôt de capital) for SAS formation, plus multi-currency operating account (EUR/USD/GBP) with IBAN
Operational professional current account with capital-escrow line and trade-finance desk for documentary letters of credit
Professional operational account with sub-account segregation for Amazon settlements and import documentary-credit facility
Operational current account with SEPA B2B direct-debit mandate and treasury-pooling module
Professional account with digital KYC onboarding and multi-currency settlement sub-ledger

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High for ACPR/EU/EEA-regulated fintech and e-money institutions; conditional for offshore providers. The French SAS may lawfully use Qonto (ACPR-licensed credit institution) and Stripe (ACPR-licensed payment institution) as operating and settlement rails; Airwallex is viable through its EU/EEA EMI authorization or its French branch-agent arrangement for multi-currency collection and FX conversion. A critical legal constraint is that an unlicensed offshore EMI without an EU/EEA passport cannot lawfully hold funds or issue French IBANs for the SAS, and engaging such a provider exposes the entity to ACPR enforcement risk as an unregulated service dependency. The recommended blueprint therefore confines fintech EMIs to collection, FX conversion and payment-acceleration sub-rails, while the Tier-1 French commercial bank remains the executive liquidity anchor and final settlement destination.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No absolute statutory obligation requires all directors to appear physically, but de facto compliance practice for Tier-1 French banks requires at least one bank-verified identity interview per director/UBO. This interview may be satisfied through physical branch attendance or a documented live videoconference with electronic signature pursuant to Article 1367 of the French Civil Code and ACPR guidance on distance onboarding. Pure remote account opening is practically available only through ACPR-regulated neo-banks. For a foreign-director SAS, best practice is an initial in-branch visit by the legal representative, apostilled board resolutions, passport verification and presentation of the French registered-office contract; a processing window of 10 to 20 business days should be budgeted at Tier-1 institutions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident directors or UBOs without French tax-residency receipts and screened against tax-haven, sanctions or high-risk jurisdiction matrices.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passport and proof-of-address for each director; French tax identification evidence or a foreign tax-residence certificate; completed beneficial-owner declaration (RBE) filed with the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; extrait Kbis of the SAS; appointment minutes; registered-office lease at the French siège social; and three-to-six months of personal bank statements proving the source of the initial capital contribution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital-escrow funding derived from cryptocurrency conversion, mixed family financing or unregulated payment-provider accounts, triggering enhanced source-of-funds review.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed attestation de financement (source-of-funds declaration); complete crypto-exchange transaction history with redemption receipts; chain-of-custody withdrawal attestations from the exchange; gift-deed evidence where applicable; and a bank memorandum supporting release of the blocked capital account upon registration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Amazon FBA operations classified as high-volume aggregated marketplace settlements with volatile USD-to-EUR flows and no demonstrable underlying trade documentation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Amazon Seller Central account summary; monthly settlement statements; FBA inventory shipment manifests; customs entry summaries (ECS/EI) with IOSS or DDP proof of VAT; procurement invoices and Incoterms matrix; French and intra-community VAT registration certificates; annual business plan and cash-flow forecast; and Stripe/Airwallex compliance screens evidencing low chargeback ratios and no sanctions-related activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity caused by a multi-tier foreign holding structure or trust arrangement, triggering review under Article L.561-2-2 of the French Monetary and Financial Code.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed RBE filing; full group organizational chart; incorporation extracts and current corporate-registry certificates for each intermediate entity; share-transfer ledger of the SAS; certified identity documentation for every ultimate beneficial owner; and tax-residence certificates for all shareholders in the chain.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound share-capital contributions are wired via SWIFT MT103 from a non-EEA remitter, or via SEPA Credit Transfer when the shareholder maintains an EEA IBAN, to the SAS capital escrow account (compte de dépôt de capital) at BNP Paribas or Société Générale. The remittance instruction must carry the Banque de France balance-of-payments purpose classification for direct investment, typically 'Apport de capital - Investissement direct', together with the shareholders' meeting minutes, the French incorporation draft and the source-of-funds trail. Once the SAS is operational, supplementary shareholder funding (compte courant d'associé) is settled through MT103 or SEPA CT under the associated-loan classification; all cross-border messages must include the ISO 20022 Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference (UETR), full beneficiary structure and a matching payment reference to prevent rejection or AML quarantine. Release of escrowed funds is authorized only after registration of the SAS with the Greffe and verification by the bank of the release conditions.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade payables and operating deductions use three parallel clearing rails: (i) SEPA Credit Transfer and SEPA B2B Direct Debit for EU-based costs, including recurring Amazon FBA fee collections initiated under the SAS IBAN mandate; (ii) SWIFT MT103 for non-EU transfers (China and Hong Kong suppliers, freight, customs and warehousing) with invoice number, Incoterms and UETR in the remittance fields; and (iii) Commercial Documentary Letters of Credit (UCP 600, at-sight or usance) arranged with the Société Générale or Crédit Agricole trade desks for large USD/CNY production batches requiring bank-intermediated settlement. Stripe and Airwallex payout sweeps are converted to EUR at transparent market-based rates and swept into the Tier-1 operational account on the next available treasury cycle. All non-EUR disbursements exceeding the applicable threshold are reported to the Banque de France for balance-of-payments statistics, and every payable is matched to an underlying customs-cleared import or marketplace service invoice.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable EUR/USD and EUR/GBP foreign exchange forwards (maturities from one week to twelve months) with BNP Paribas or Société Générale under an ISDA 2002 master agreement; permitted without prior French Treasury authorization when used to hedge the Amazon FBA settlement cycle.

EUR/CNH Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) referencing the CNH offshore fixing, permissible for hedging imported inventory exposure; onshore CNY remains non-deliverable for French non-resident counterparties and NDFs must be executed with the bank's global-markets desk under EMIR margin rules.

Cross-Currency Interest Rate Swaps (CCIRS) converting long-dated USD or CNY commercial borrowings into EUR, available where an underlying documented commercial debt exists and the SAS retains non-financial-counterparty status with respect to EMIR clearing thresholds.

Purchased FX options on EUR/USD and EUR/CNH, including zero-premium collars and premium-limited option spreads, used to cap conversion costs on projected FBA revenues; internal treasury policy restricts hedge notional to a maximum of 70% of the twelve-month projected marketplace turnover.

PSP-treasury automated FX conversion executed by Airwallex or Stripe at transparent mid-market rates for payment-volume conversion, recognized as a separate hedging and settlement sub-rail alongside bank deliverable forwards, with monthly consolidated reporting into the corporate treasury ledger.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of RCS data integrity (déclaration annuelle de confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, RCS via the INPI formalities portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month after each anniversary of the initial RCS registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Formal reminder after one month; continued failure initiates the interim procedure and may lead to administrative strike-off (radiation) after an adversarial phase

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual approval of statutory financial statements by shareholders (AGM or written consultation; official minutes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate record; minutes are retained and may be inspected by tax authorities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the fiscal year-end; calendar-year SAS: by 30 June of the following year unless extended by court order
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No late fee; any shareholder may petition the commercial court to convene the meeting; prolonged failure exposes legal representatives to liability and potential court-ordered penalties

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of annual financial statements (comptes annuels) with the commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Registry Office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month of shareholder approval and in no event later than 7 months from a calendar-year fiscal year-end (i.e., 31 July for a 31 December year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing: civil fine up to EUR 4,000 for entities; court may impose periodic penalty payments (astreinte) up to EUR 80 per day; non-filing impedes registry certificates and can trigger preventive strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and tax package (liasse fiscale, forms 2065 and annexes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Service des impôts des entreprises (SIE) of the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year fiscal year: no later than 30 April (or the second business day following 1 May for online filings); for other fiscal years: within 60 days of fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 10% of tax due (or 5% if compliance is regularized unprompted), monthly late-payment interest of 0.20%, automatic tax assessment, and escalation to 40% for intentional understatements

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Appointment of a Commissaire aux Comptes is mandatory for an SAS when at least two of the following three thresholds are exceeded at year-end: total balance sheet EUR 4,000,000; net turnover excluding tax EUR 8,000,000; average workforce of 50 permanent employees. An auditor is also mandatory when the SAS controls or is controlled by an entity whose aggregate activity exceeds the same thresholds, or when required by applicable group consolidation rules.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général, PCG) under ANC regulation 2016-07; EU-endorsed IFRS is required for consolidated accounts of listed groups and optional for non-listed consolidated financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate annual UBO return is filed in France. The RBE (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs) is declared at incorporation and updated within 30 days of any change. The annual RCS confirmation procedure obliges the legal representative to confirm that registered UBO data remain accurate, and if a share transfer altered direct or indirect ownership above 25% or effective control, an updated UBO declaration must be filed with the Greffe before or simultaneously with the annual confirmation. Failures are punishable by criminal fines up to EUR 15,000 and potential imprisonment for intentional false declarations.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registre des titres (statutory register of shareholders and share-transfer record)
Registre des procès-verbaux des décisions collectives (minute book of shareholder meetings and written consultations)
Registre des documents comptables et pièces justificatives (statutory accounting books and original vouchers)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 130-780 per year (EUR 11-65 per month) for a commercial registered-office or legal-agent service
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000-25,000 per year for a small or mid-size SAS requiring a statutory audit

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard corporate income tax rate for fiscal years opened on/after 1 January 2022; eligible SMEs may benefit from a 15% reduced rate on the first €42,000 of taxable profit annually)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Research tax credit (CIR) up to 30% on eligible R&D expenditure; innovation tax credit (CII) at 20% for certain SMEs; jeunesse entreprise innovante (JEI) payroll tax exemptions; reduced 15% rate for SMEs under EUR 38,120 taxable income; no general tax holiday applies to Amazon FBA retail activity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulaire n°2065-SD (liasse fiscale) with annexes 2051 to 2058-SD; mandatory electronic filing via GTC (Gestion de la Téléprocédure Choruse) / EDI-TDFC on impots.gouv.fr
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Calendar-year companies: second working day after 1 May of the following year; off-calendar-year companies: within three months of the fiscal year-end; automatic extension may apply to online filers assisted by a licensed accountant.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current-year taxable profit or loss before absorption of tax loss carryforwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only French-entity taxable profit; apply permanent establishment attribution and separate-entity rules under the applicable DTA.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax losses carried forward and deducted against current-year net profit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses realised by the French tax-registered entity are deductible; losses of a foreign head office are not eligible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax-recognised depreciation schedules for tangible and intangible fixed assets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Capital allowances restricted to assets actually used by the French entity in France; no depreciation for assets of foreign branches.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-deductible expenses reintegrated into taxable income and extra-accounting deductions applied.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include transfer pricing adjustments, thin-capitalisation add-backs, and controlled foreign company inclusions; support deductions with transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits reducing or refunding corporate income tax liability.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only the French legal entity may file French tax credits; non-resident shareholders cannot claim them directly.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 10% increase of tax due (40% for bad faith, 80% for fraud); late payment interest at 0.20% per month; additional 5% penalty for non-payment by due date; can trigger official tax assessment and criminal sanctions.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 25% for non-resident corporate shareholders on gross distributed dividends; 30% for non-resident individuals (12.8% PFU plus 17.2% social levies), subject to treaty reductions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Deliver Form 5000 or a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) to the French paying agent before distribution; for EU corporate shareholders satisfying the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive conditions (≥10% holding and 24-month holding period), 0% withholding may apply; otherwise request a refund under Article 242 ter CGI where excess withholding is collected.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory withholding 33.33%, reduced to 0% under EU Interest & Royalties Directive for associated EU companies or to 0-10% under DTAs; interest: statutory withholding generally 0% for qualifying lending institutions and taxpayers, except 26.5% for payments to certain non-cooperative jurisdictions; DTA rates commonly 0%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Master File required where the French entity's annual turnover or gross assets exceed EUR 400 million, or where the group consolidated turnover exceeds EUR 400 million (Article L.13 AA CGI); simplified documentation may be required where group turnover exceeds EUR 50 million.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France does not apply Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) in the Gulf model; however, genuine substance (staff, premises, management and strategic decision-making in France) is required to rely on DTA benefits, EU directives, and to defeat the French general anti-abuse rule (abus de droit, Article L.64 LPF).

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Wilful Failure to File
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting Amazon FBA retail sales, underreporting online marketplace turnover, or concealing foreign bank accounts receiving proceeds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty: 40% (bad faith) or 80% (fraud) of unpaid tax plus late-payment interest at 0.20% per month; criminal conviction: fine up to €500,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years under Article 1741 CGI.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be held criminally liable as authors or accomplices; managing director of the SAS faces imprisonment, fines, civil restitution of avoided taxes, travel restrictions, and possible asset seizure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Creating a French SAS without economic substance solely to route Amazon FBA profits to a low-tax jurisdiction or to claim treaty benefits without any real commercial activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Abuse of law recharacterisation under Article L.64 LPF; 80% penalty in case of abuse; income reallocated to the actual beneficial owner, plus late-payment interest and potential loss of treaty protections.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: If the director controls the artificial shell, the corporate veil can be pierced for tax debts and penalties; directors may face joint and several liability, travel bans, and criminal prosecution for fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Misallocating profits, inflating intercompany royalties, booking non-arm's-length service fees, or artificially pricing inventory in Amazon FBA cross-border transactions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Transfer pricing adjustment under Article 57 CGI; add-back of artificial profits; penalties of 40% or 80% for unjustified documentation; late-payment interest; possible criminal tax evasion charges.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false transfer pricing documentation can face personal administrative fines and civil liability; in serious cases criminal sanctions apply and personal assets of directors may be attached under Article L.267 LPF.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using an opaque SAS with concealed ultimate beneficial owners, unexplained payment rails, or inconsistent third-party settlement flows involving Amazon Pay, Stripe, or Airwallex to launder sales proceeds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AML violations under Articles L.561-1 et seq. of the Monetary and Financial Code: administrative fines up to €1 million or up to 10% of annual turnover; criminal money laundering sanctions up to 10 years' imprisonment and confiscation of funds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors directly involved may face criminal liability, personal fines, travel restrictions, provisional attachment of personal assets, and civil damages to third-party creditors.
